subject: How specify ARMA(1,1) in latent growth model with simsem?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: How specify ARMA(1,1) in latent growth model with simsem?
parts:
Hi, all,

I want to specify the ARMA(1,1) structure at indicator residual in the latent growth model with simsem as population model. How can do that?

Best,
Seongho

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: How specify ARMA(1,1) in latent growth model with simsem?
parts: I want to specify the ARMA(1,1) structure at indicator residual in the latent growth model with simsem as population model. How can do that?

Can you estimate a LGC model with ARMA(1, 1) in lavaan?  If so, you can use the same model syntax to generate the data, with population values specified, as seen in the ?simulateData help page.  At the very least, you can use that model syntax as the data-generation specification in simsem (i.e., the generate argument for the sim() function), but because lavaan uses LISREL representation, you can equivalently specify it using LISREL matrices in simsem.

If you can post the lavaan model you want to simulate from, I can perhaps help from there.
